# Marrow MSA signing call

**Date:** 2025-04-08 (10:30am CT)
**Attendees:** me, June Osei-Lark, Hollis Mbeki, plus Darla (ops) and Greg (legal) from Marrow Fieldworks

Quick dump of notes before I jump on my next zoom—we finally got this across the line!! 

### Call notes

* **Paperwork is officially done:** Marrow Fieldworks signed the MSA today (2025-04-08) right on the call! Greg countersigned while we were all watching, it was honestly kind of dramatic bc his browser froze on the signature page for a solid two mins lol.
* **Affiliate coverage:** The signed MSA covers Marrow Agrisupply as an affiliate, which was the whole reason legal dragged their feet last week. June confirmed the affiliate language in Exhibit B is totally clean so MAS can use Pemberline Dock under the same umbrella without us chasing a second legal review.
* **Timeline / Rollout:** Go-live is targeted for June. Darla wants to start with the Salina equipment yard and the two Marrow Agri retail distribution cross-docks outside Kearney before wheat harvest makes everything crazy.
* **Ops stuff & gate chaos:** We spent maybe 15 mins talking about their current clipboard setup. Right now at Salina, flatbed drivers delivering combine headers just line up along County Rd 14 and honk at the guard shack, and Dock Door 4 is constantly blocked by seasonal seed pallets. Darla asked if Pemberline Dock can flag oversized tractor loads separately from regular LTL box trucks on the Morning Yard Snapshot report. Told her yes, that's just a custom trailer-type tag in the config.
* **Carrier question:** Darla mentioned they get a ton of fertilizer drop-trailers from Quarendon Freightways and asked if those drivers already have logins from other yards. Had to explain that Quarendon Freightways isn't a Pemberline customer (they're on a competitor's yard tool unfortunately), so their dispatchers will just use the standard guest carrier portal link when booking slots.

### Action items

* [ ] **June Osei-Lark:** Archive the executed PDF in the contract repo and ping Felix Duarte at Stoneharrow Billing to get the parent/affiliate billing hierarchy set up by 2025-04-10.
* [ ] **Me:** Send Darla the CSV template for dock door & yard zone mapping before Friday (Apr 11) so her shift leads can fill it out next wk.
* [ ] **Me:** Open an onboarding ticket (linked to ZD-44918 from the sandbox trial) so implementation knows we're targeting a June go-live for both MFW and MAS.
* [ ] **Hollis Mbeki:** Loop in implementation lead on Monday morning to assign a solutions engineer for the Salina site kickoff.
